entry.title: Poliwow 1.3.0
entry.summary: One-knob build-up effect: turn Wow up for risers, sweeps and tails **For:** second-generation MPCs (MPC Live III, One G2, Key G2, XL) on MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. **Tested on:** MPC Live III, MPC OS 3.10.1. **Install:** from the Open MPC catalog or the Plugin Manager, or by hand: unzip, copy the folder inside `portable/` into `VST2 Plugins` at the root of a drive, turn on Preferences > Enhancements > External Plugin Support and restart the MPC. `Poliwow-1.3.0-mpc-aarch64.zip` SHA-256: `d45bd86d84f
